_comment: Map each company slug to its investor-relations / reports page(s). Copy this file to report_watcher.config.json and edit. 'patterns' (optional) are extra regexes (matched case-insensitively against the URL) on top of the built-in report patterns. 'domains' (optional) restricts downloads to these registrable domains — the watcher only ever fetches from official IR domains; if omitted, the domains are derived from the 'urls' above.
